actions.code: (() => { const base='{{baseUrl}}'; const abs=(u)=>{try{return new URL(u,base).href;}catch(e){return u||'';}}; const txt=(el)=>el?(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim():''; const bad=(h)=>!/\/mh-[^/]+\/?$/i.test(h)||/\/mh-(updated|ranklist|list)(-|\/|$)/i.test(h); const results=[]; const seen={}; const pick=()=>{ const groups=['.updateList .item','.searchResult .item','.bookList_2 .item','.sideRankList li']; for(let i=0;i<groups.length;i++){ const nodes=document.querySelectorAll(groups[i]); if(nodes.length>0) return nodes; } return []; }; const containers=pick(); containers.forEach((item)=>{ const titleLink=item.querySelector('p.title a[href*="/mh-"],a.comic[href*="/mh-"]')||item.querySelector('a[href*="/mh-"]'); if(!titleLink) return; const href=titleLink.getAttribute('href')||''; if(bad(href)) return; const itemUrl=abs(href); if(!itemUrl||seen[itemUrl]) return; const img=item.querySelector('img.cover,.img img,.cover img,img'); let cover=img?(img.getAttribute('data-src')||img.getAttribute('src')||''):''; if(/css99tel|logo|btn_|searchResult_logo|noData|login/i.test(cover)) cover=''; const latest=item.querySelector('a.op[href*="/m"],.op[href*="/m"],a[href*="/m"]'); const author=item.querySelector('.avatar'); const desc=item.querySelector('.tip,.ibcont'); seen[itemUrl]=true; results.push({id:itemUrl,title:txt(titleLink)||titleLink.getAttribute('title')||(img?img.getAttribute('alt')||'':''),url:itemUrl,cover:cover?abs(cover):'',author:txt(author),description:txt(desc),latestChapter:txt(latest)}); }); return JSON.stringify(results); })();

(() => { const raw=String('{{mangaId}}'||'').trim(); let url=raw; if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)){ url='{{baseUrl}}/'+url.replace(/^\/+/, ''); } if(url.indexOf('?')<0&&!/\/$/.test(url)) url+='/'; return url; })();

(() => { const base='{{baseUrl}}'; const abs=(u)=>{try{return new URL(u,base).href;}catch(e){return u||'';}}; const txt=(el)=>el?(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim():''; const root=document.querySelector('.comicInfo')||document; const titleNode=root.querySelector('.info > p.title'); let title=''; if(titleNode){ const c=titleNode.cloneNode(true); const g=c.querySelector('.grading'); if(g) g.remove(); title=txt(c); } const coverEl=root.querySelector('.cover .img img,.comicInfo img[alt]'); const cover=coverEl?(coverEl.getAttribute('data-src')||coverEl.getAttribute('src')||''):''; const author=txt(root.querySelector('.info .avatar')); const description=txt(root.querySelector('p.content')); const gray=txt(root.querySelector('p.gray')); const genreMatch=gray.match(/类\s*别：([^状]+)/); const statusMatch=gray.match(/状\s*态：(.+)$/); return JSON.stringify({id:location.href,title:title,cover:cover?abs(cover):'',author:author,description:description,status:statusMatch?statusMatch[1].trim():'',genre:genreMatch?genreMatch[1].trim():'',url:location.href}); })();

(() => { const txt=(el)=>el?(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim():''; const chapters=[]; const seen={}; document.querySelectorAll('#chapterlistload a[href*="/m"]').forEach((a)=>{ const href=a.getAttribute('href')||''; let url=''; try{ url=new URL(href,location.href||'{{baseUrl}}').href; }catch(e){ url=href; } if(!/\/m\d+\//.test(url)||seen[url]) return; seen[url]=true; chapters.push({id:url,title:txt(a)||href,url:url}); }); return JSON.stringify(chapters); })();

(() => { const raw=String('{{chapterId}}'||'').trim(); let url=raw; if(!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)){ url='{{baseUrl}}/'+url.replace(/^\/+/, ''); } if(url.indexOf('?')<0&&!/\/$/.test(url)) url+='/'; return url; })();

(() => { const raw=String('{{chapterId}}'||location.pathname); const m=raw.match(/m(\d+)/)||location.pathname.match(/m(\d+)/); const cid=m?m[1]:''; if(!cid) throw new Error('Manben missing chapter id'); const bodyText=document.body?(document.body.textContent||''):''; if(bodyText.indexOf('章节数据缺少')>=0||bodyText.indexOf('屏蔽处理')>=0) throw new Error('Manben chapter is blocked or missing'); const pages=[]; const seen={}; const push=(pix,img,size)=>{ if(!img) return; let url=String(img); if(!/^https?:/i.test(url)){ url=String(pix||'').replace(/\/$/,'')+'/'+url.replace(/^\//,''); } if(seen[url]) return; seen[url]=true; const item={index:pages.length,page:pages.length,url:url,imageUrl:url}; const sm=String(size||'').match(/(\d+)\/(\d+)/); if(sm){ item.width=parseInt(sm[1],10); item.height=parseInt(sm[2],10); } pages.push(item); }; for(let group=1; group<=80; group++){ const xhr=new XMLHttpRequest(); xhr.open('POST','{{baseUrl}}/imageshow.ashx?d='+Date.now(),false); xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type','application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8'); xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With','XMLHttpRequest'); xhr.send('cid='+encodeURIComponent(cid)+'&page='+group+'&showtype=1&ispre=0'); if(xhr.status<200||xhr.status>=400) break; const text=String(xhr.responseText||''); if(!text) break; const jm=text.match(/var\s+chapterimage\s*=\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\});?\s*$/); if(!jm) break; const data=JSON.parse(jm[1]); const imgs=data.Images||[]; const sizes=data.ImageSize||[]; for(let i=0;i<imgs.length;i++) push(data.ImagePix,imgs[i],sizes[i]); if(data.IsEnd) break; } if(pages.length===0) throw new Error('Manben page list extraction returned empty'); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
